name: Clean Email
title: clean.email
shortDescription: Clean Email is designed to help manage overloaded mailboxes by organizing emails into smart folders and bundles. It automates tasks like unsubscribing from unwanted lists and archiving old emails. Ideal for individuals and businesses alike, it simplifies email management across all devices and email providers. An example use case is achieving Inbox Zero by automating the cleaning of social network notifications.
pros: Supports all major email providers and devices
Enhances privacy and security of email data
cons: Requires a paid upgrade for full functionality
May not support very specific email providers
Potential privacy concerns with email access
